ideas.title: Investigating the Trump Administration's Funding Freeze
ideas.description: This story would investigate the motivations behind the Trump administration's funding freeze for social services and the impact on vulnerable populations.
questions: What are the motivations behind the funding freeze?
How will the freeze affect vulnerable populations?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover important information about the Trump administration's priorities and the impact of their policies on vulnerable populations. By following the money and examining public records, we may be able to shed light on the motivations behind the funding freeze and the consequences for those affected.
